## Execution acceptance

- [ ] Exact environment profile/hash:
- [ ] Exact compiled configuration/manifest hash:
- [ ] Executable and version:
- [ ] Authentication/connectivity state (handles only; no secrets):
- [ ] Exact capability canary:
- [ ] Expected result:
- [ ] Independently observed result:
- [ ] Hashed execution receipt:
- [ ] Rollback result/evidence:
- [ ] Value Ledger cost/savings/outcome hook, where relevant:

`DONE` or `VERIFIED` must not be claimed from source code, CI, configuration, or deployment status alone. `CONFIGURED -> VERIFIED` requires a successful independently observed execution receipt.
